title: stephanomeria exigua var. carotifera
intro: Stephanomeria exigua var. carotifera, commonly known as Desert Globe Mallow, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as colds and fever. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Desert Globe Mallow include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
